architecture.falsification_test: On a dyno and road-test fleet of 2020 Elantra units exhibiting the documented symptom, compare vehicles with the CT-BERT-style adaptive TCM intervention versus stock TCM across 500 acceleration events; the intervention must reduce RPM-revving magnitude (>500 rpm above commanded) by ≥70% and eliminate driveline shudder in ≥90% of cases (p<0.05 vs. control) with no new DTCs set.
